_about: The bedroom media box (an X88 Pro 13 Android TV box) as a deployment target, like the room pods. tools/media_box.py makes the box match this file: every app is pinned by the SHA-256 of the file it installs (a download that does not match is refused), so changing a pin is the one deliberate way to update an app. Packages in `remove` are the stock apps taken off for the user (reversible: cmd package install-existing <package>).
name: bedroom-media-box

apps.name: Moonlight
apps.why: the console: streams Steam Big Picture from skippy-pc's Sunshine

apps.name: Plex
apps.why: plays skippy-pc's Plex library directly (the box decodes H.264/HEVC itself)
